tickets.title: Implement core API routes and JSON persistence
tickets.description: Build API routes for create, list, update-complete, and delete task operations with atomic local JSON file persistence and input validation. Authentication, authorization, secrets, and tenant data are not applicable for this single-user local MVP, but API routes are in scope.

tickets.title: Build single-page task list interface
tickets.description: Implement the mobile-friendly single-page UI with top inline add field, checkbox completion toggle, and delete icon without confirmation. Completed tasks must always sort to the bottom with no separate add or detail route.

tickets.title: Integrate API with UI state and error handling
tickets.description: Connect the task-list UI to backend API routes and implement deterministic success/error behavior for add, toggle, and delete actions. Ensure accessibility semantics, keyboard support, and resilient retry/recovery flows from the UX specifications.

tickets.title: Add automated test coverage for MVP flows
tickets.description: Create unit and headless Playwright tests for add, list, complete/reopen, delete, ordering, and persistence across restart/refresh behavior. Include API routes verification coverage in test scenarios and enforce repeatable local pass criteria.

tickets.title: Wire quality gates and execution scripts
tickets.description: Finalize project scripts and CI checks for typecheck, lint, build, and test execution in alignment with Phase 4 locked tooling and Phase 5 evidence expectations. Keep scope focused on MVP reliability with no out-of-scope feature expansion.
